data.narrative:
Freenome is a public-stage biotech and health company currently valued at $1.1B, having raised $1.3B+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 5 same-sector comparables spanning both private (Series B/C) and public stages, with valuations ranging from $539M to $3.8B. This set includes Recursion Pharmaceuticals and Alto Neuroscience as public anchors, alongside higher-valued private peers Chai Discovery ($3.8B) and New Limit ($3.1B).

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given that target revenue is unavailable, precluding a P/S multiple analysis against the 8.1x median observed across three public Biotech & Health comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L). The peer cohort median valuation is $1.6B, bracketed by a range of $539M to $3.8B. This single-method triangulation yields a valuation range of $1.4B (low) to $1.8B (high), with $1.6B as the median implied value.

The analysis supports a $1.4B–$1.8B valuation range, centered at $1.6B, implying modest upside from Freenome's current $1.1B valuation. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and near-term profitability trajectory, neither disclosed in public filings, which would strengthen confidence in any multiple-based approach and narrow the range substantially.
